subject: Partial remittance schedule request — Carapace renewal
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@carapace.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@carapace.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: partial remittance schedule for Redwood renewal

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Carapace is excited to move forward with Redwood for inference across our analytics workloads. Finance has one ask on timing we hope you can accommodate before we issue the PO.

Due to our fiscal close and cash flow cycles, we need to invoice the first year across three remittances: 35% at contract effective date, 35% at ~60 days, and 30% at ~120 days. All invoices would be standard AP invoices and paid Net-90 from invoice date.

I've attached the PO draft (Carapace_PO_4379.pdf) and a proposed remit schedule for your review. We realize this is non-standard; if Redwood requires a small administrative fee or an added clause, let us know and we'll review internally.

Can you confirm whether Finance at Redwood can approve this structure or if an alternate compromise is preferred? We are targeting a signed agreement by 11/30 to align with our renewal window.

Best,
Emma Liu
Director, Procurement
Carapace Systems
[Attachment: Carapace_PO_4379.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Emma Liu <emma@carapace.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: partial remittance schedule for Redwood renewal

Hi Emma — appreciate the clear note and the PO.

Redwood generally bills on standard Net-30 terms, but we do offer exceptions for strategic renewals and certain enterprise procurement calendars. I can propose the following compromise to our Finance team: 30% due on signature, 40% due 60 days after signature, 30% due 120 days after signature; all invoices Net-60 from invoice date (we are uncomfortable with Net-90 without an additional offset). Alternatively, we can keep Net-90 if Carapace agrees to a 1.5% administrative fee applied to amounts invoiced beyond Net-60.

Next steps from my side: I'll route this to our Finance and Legal leads for a quick review and approval. If you can countersign the PO and indicate which option you'd prefer (Net-60 or Net-90 + fee), I will push the addendum and the DocuSign link.

I've attached a tentative remit schedule reflecting the 30/40/30 split.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
[Attachment: proposed_remit_schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)]

Subject: Internal: Carapace remit request — need approval / guidance

Laura / Neha / Karthik,

Forwarding Carapace's request (attached). Key facts: ARR-equivalent first-year invoice ~ $420,000; PO ready; customer requests 3-way remittance and Net-90 from invoice date. They are open to a compromise.

Options I recommend we consider:
- Option A (preferred from AE): 30% / 40% / 30% split with Net-60 payment terms (no fee).
- Option B: Accept Net-90 but add 1.5% administrative fee for amounts beyond Net-60 (one-time fee on second/third remittances).
- Option C: Decline Net-90, require escrow or letter of credit (not ideal for speed).

Notes: Carapace is strategic in our target vertical and likely to expand usage quickly if onboarding goes smoothly. Risk tolerance: moderate; Finance needs guardrails on exposure.

Can Finance approve Option A up to $500k without exec escalation? If not, I'll need a sign-off from leadership. Karthik — any quick legal language we should add to the addendum to protect Redwood on late payments (interest, suspension clause)?

Jonas
Senior AE — Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 12:20 PM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Carapace remit request — need approval / guidance

Team —

I reviewed the ask and the deal economics. Given the strategic nature and the fact the total first-year commitment is sub-$500k, I approve Option A (30/40/30 with Net-60 invoices) on the following conditions:

1) Jon-as/Account must obtain a signed PO (Carapace_PO_4379.pdf) before any work begins.
2) Legal (Karthik) to prepare a two-paragraph Non-Standard Payment Terms Addendum that includes: suspension rights for non-payment, 1.5% monthly late interest after terms lapse, and explicit milestone definitions tied to invoice triggers.
3) Finance (Neha) to reserve right to convert to prepayment if the second remittance is late; collect first payment by wire within 14 days of signature.
4) No changes to list price or additional discounting tied to this schedule.

If those items are included and the addendum is signed via DocuSign, Finance will process the 30-day invoice cadence as Net-60. Laura B approves; no additional executive escalation required.

Jonas — please send the DocuSign addendum link to Emma, attach the PO, and confirm the customer's chosen option. Once signed, update the HubSpot deal (link below) and mark contract executed.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
